{"content":"## Three NIST Post-Quantum Standards, Two Functions

In August 2024, the Secretary of Commerce approved the first three NIST post-quantum standards: FIPS 203, FIPS 204 and FIPS 205. All three are designed to resist future quantum attacks, but they serve two different functions.

FIPS 203 specifies ML-KEM, which establishes a shared secret between parties communicating over a public channel. FIPS 204 and FIPS 205 specify digital signature schemes: FIPS 204 is module-lattice-based, while FIPS 205 is stateless hash-based.

Together, the standards cover shared-secret establishment and digital signatures. Their common design aim does not make their functions the same."}
